text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Eileen Avenue, between Scarlett Road and Florence Crescent. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Eileen Avenue.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Eileen Avenue, between Scarlett Road and Florence Crescent. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of five (5) speed humps on Eileen Avenue, between Scarlett Road and Florence Crescent, generally as shown on Attachment 2 to the report (September 5, 2024) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
